sentences.english: She works a lot at the clinic.
Ana sits down at the table.
On the table there are two plates.

sentences.text: Ana e merr çajin dhe lexon.
sentences.english: Ana takes the tea and reads.

sentences.text: Orizi, buka dhe djathi janë të mira.
sentences.english: The rice, the bread and the cheese are good.

sentences.text: Sot Sam ha darkë te Drita.
sentences.english: Today Sam has dinner at Drita's.

sentences.text: Gjyshja Drita bën bukë dhe oriz.
sentences.english: Grandmother Drita makes bread and rice.
The plates are on the table.
Everyone sits down at the table.

sentences.text: — Mirë se vjen, Sam! Hyr, të lutem.
— Shtëpia juaj është shumë e bukur.
Pastaj Ardi dhe Sam lajnë pjatat.
sentences.english: Then Ardi and Sam wash the plates.

sentences.text: Te Dritani babai vjen nga puna.
sentences.english: At Dritan's the father comes home from work.

sentences.text: Ai është i lodhur, por i lumtur.
Mira, gruaja e Dritanit, e ka bërë darkën.
sentences.english: Mira, Dritan's wife, has made the dinner.
"How was the day?" asks the father.

sentences.text: — Mësuesi na dha një libër të ri.
sentences.english: "The teacher gave us a new book."

sentences.text: — Unë i shkrova gjyshes, — thotë Elira.
Pas darkës fëmijët lajnë pjatat dhe luajnë.
sentences.english: After dinner the children wash the plates and play.

sentences.text: Dje Sam ishte në kishë me Luanin.
sentences.english: Yesterday Sam was at church with Luan.

sentences.text: Sam i jep Luanit një letër.
— Luan, a beson te Perëndia? — pyet Sam.
sentences.english: "Luan, do you believe in God?" asks Sam.

sentences.text: — Drita shkon në kishë çdo të diel.
— Mirë. Unë dua të lexoj Biblën me ty.
sentences.english: "Good. I want to read the Bible with you."

sentences.text: Pastaj Sam fillon të lexojë me Luanin.
sentences.english: Then Sam begins to read with Luan.
